description: Atmospheric nitrous oxide concentration from NOAA ESRL — monthly readings in ppb since 2001. N2O is a potent greenhouse gas with 273x the warming potential of CO2. Returns last 10 years by default.

years.description: Number of years of data to return (1-50, default 10). Data is monthly.
